reapack.desc: Wwise Tool (send REAPER audio to Wwise)

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Renamed from "Wwise Transfer" to "Wwise Tool". Your saved settings, presets and colors carry over automatically. If you had "Wwise Transfer" installed, uninstall it in ReaPack and re-add any shortcuts or toolbar buttons.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: The preview's Initial delay column now shows seconds by default (42 ms shows as 0.042 s, like Wwise). Switch between seconds and milliseconds in Settings > Window, or right-click a value in that column. The choice is remembered.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Presets are now split in two, so loading one only changes what you meant to change: - Structure presets (button under Wwise structure): just the levels, names, templates and the Sound row. - Settings presets (button at the top of the left side): everything else, such as source, destination, Originals subfolder, conflict choice, Initial Delay, and the render and transfer options in Settings. Your existing presets carry over: each one becomes a structure preset and a settings preset with the same name.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Fixed: when the Sound row's name is empty and several items share a container name (for example $region), containers no longer get "-001", "-002"... added to their names. They're now merged into one container, as intended.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Channels column: pick several rows and set them all at once. Click and drag down the column, Shift+click for a range, or Ctrl+click to add or remove a row; when you let go the menu opens and Mono, Stereo or Auto applies to every picked row. Right-click also opens it. Esc clears the pick. Double-clicking the title bar no longer collapses the window. It now fills the screen the window is on, and double-clicking again puts it back. A window left collapsed by an older version opens normally again. The window now only moves by its title bar, so dragging in the preview doesn't move it. Also includes 1.11.1: when the Sound row's name is empty and several items share a container name (for example $region), containers no longer get "-001", "-002"... added to their names. They're now merged into one container, as intended.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: You can drag the window from anywhere again, not just the title bar. Picking rows in the Channels column still never moves the window. Double-clicking the title bar now fits the window exactly to the screen it's on (above the taskbar), also with Windows display scaling. This is exact when js_ReaScriptAPI is installed.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Double-clicking the title bar no longer changes the window size; it does nothing. The window opens at its standard size (put back once if an earlier version made it screen-sized) and you resize it by dragging its edges as usual.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: The window opens right away again. Connecting to Wwise now happens after the window is up, a step per frame, and each call gives up after 3 seconds, so a busy or stuck Wwise can no longer freeze REAPER (it used to wait up to 2 minutes). If Wwise is busy, it tries again on its own every few seconds.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: New Streaming column in the preview: click a Sound or container (or pick many rows with drag, Shift+click or Ctrl+click) and choose Stream, No stream or Auto. Settings > Streaming adds Auto streaming for every Sound at least N seconds long, and can turn on Zero latency and Non-cachable along with streaming. Streaming is written after property templates, so a template can't undo it. Preview columns can now be dragged into any order (Name stays first); the order is remembered, and right-click a header > Reset order brings back the original.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Transferring from a REAPER project that has never been saved now stops with a clear message: "Save the REAPER project first". The Transfer button is greyed out with the same message until you save (only when something needs rendering; items sent as they are still work in an unsaved project). The Transfer to Wwise button is now green (#1a7f37) when it's ready to click.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Settings is now split into tabs: Connection, Rendering, Channels, Transfer, Streaming, Interface (window and type colors) and Diagnostics. The window keeps its size when you switch tabs, and you can resize it; long tabs scroll.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Wwise structure: + Add level now has - Remove level and move up/down arrow buttons next to it. They act on the selected level (click its type or name; it's highlighted), or the bottom level when none is selected. Each row's "..." button is now a clipboard icon that only holds the property template. It turns amber when a template is set, and the popup has a Clear button.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: New Loop column in the preview, like Streaming: click a Sound or container (or pick many rows with drag, Shift+click or Ctrl+click) and choose Loop (infinite), No loop or Auto (leave it as Wwise or the template has it). Written after property templates. Settings tab "Streaming" is now "Stream & loop" and has Clear loop overrides.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Tabs: a row of tabs under the toolbar, each holding a whole setup (Wwise structure and every setting), so you can flick between setups with one click. "+" adds a tab that starts as a copy of the one showing; double-click a tab to rename it; right-click for Rename, Duplicate, Move left/right and Close. Closing asks first. Tabs are saved with the project (and carry over to new projects). Structure and settings presets load into the tab that's showing. Quick send uses the showing tab.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Originals subfolder: Browse now lets you pick any folder in Originals\SFX or Originals\Voices\<language>, not only the one for the current Sound type. Picking a Voices folder switches the Sound to Sound Voice in that language (and the import uses that language); picking an SFX folder switches it back to Sound SFX. Typing a path that starts with SFX\ or Voices\<language>\ does the same.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Wwise structure: the Add level and Remove level buttons are now small + and - buttons, with "Add level" / "Remove level" tooltips, so they take less room.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Tabs can have their own color. Right-click a tab: pick its color from the swatch, rename it in place, close it, Reset color, Duplicate, or change the tab order with the arrow buttons. Colors are saved with the tabs; a new or duplicated tab keeps the color of the tab it was copied from. Light colors get dark text so names stay readable.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: The preview's top row now shows what the destination is in Wwise, read from Wwise: [WWU] for a Work Unit, [VF] Virtual Folder, [PF] Physical Folder, [AM] Actor-Mixer, [RND]/[SEQ]/[SW]/[BLD] for containers, in that type's color. It shows [DEST] while Wwise isn't connected or the destination doesn't exist. Work Units are now tagged [WWU] instead of [WU].

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Work Units are tagged [WU] again. The destination's real type ([WU], [RND]...) still shows on the preview's top row. The preview's "Audio" column is now "File from", with clearer values: Original WAV (imported as is, no render), Item render, Folder render, Project render. Hover the header or a value to see what it means.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: The preview's "File from" column is now called "Source" (values unchanged: Original WAV, Item render, Folder render, Project render; hover for what each means).

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: The header line (status dot, Wwise project name and Wwise version) is a little bigger.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Wwise structure: every level row now has its own + and - buttons at the right. + adds a new level right below that row, - removes that row. The Sound row's + adds a level just above the Sound. The buttons stay on their rows, so nothing shifts under the mouse. To reorder levels, drag the handle at the left of a row onto another row. The old buttons under the list are gone.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Bigger close button: a large X at the right end of the top line (next to Settings), about four times the size of the old title-bar X. It turns red on hover. The small title-bar X is gone.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: The big close X is back up in the window's top-right corner, where the old X was, at the same big size (the title bar is a little taller to fit it). The top line is back to how it was. When the window is docked, its tab has the normal X.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Fixed: 1.16.6 stopped with an ImGui_End error ("Code uses SetCursorPos()/SetCursorScreenPos() to extend window/parent boundaries") because of the new corner close button.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Rounded corners on the Wwise Tool window and on the Transfer to Wwise button.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: The close button is now a red rounded square with a white X, set in a little from the window's top-right corner (same size as before). The title bar is a bit taller to fit it.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: The close button is dark gray and only turns red when you hover over it.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: New Source: "Folder items". Only the selected folder items are sent, and any selected items inside them are ignored, so NVK Folder Items' auto-select can stay on.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Folder items mode now finds NVK folder items (they can have a take, so 1.17.0 missed them). In that mode any item on a folder track counts as a folder item. Selected items mode also treats an empty-take item on a folder track as a folder item.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Dark grey look: buttons, dropdowns, fields, checkboxes, list highlights, tabs and the other spots that used ImGui's default blue are now dark grey. Includes 1.17.1: Folder items mode now finds NVK folder items (they can have a take, so 1.17.0 missed them). In that mode any item on a folder track counts as a folder item. Selected items mode also treats an empty-take item on a folder track as a folder item.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Several folder items now render in one pass (through a temporary region render matrix) instead of opening the render window once per folder item. "Render folder items through master" still renders them one at a time.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Folder items render in one pass with "Render folder items through master" on too (region render matrix via master). The version shown in the window (and the diagnostics log) now matches the package version. 1.17.x and 1.18.1 still showed an older number there.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Settings > Diagnostics > "Copy last render log" lists what the last transfer rendered (tracks, temporary regions, render settings, files), to track down the missing FX on folder items rendered through master.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Layout and styling: "Transfer to Wwise" moves to the bottom left of the window, with its status text beside it. Dropdowns, fields and buttons get slightly rounded corners. Bigger, matching section titles on the left (Source, Wwise destination, Wwise structure). "Settings presets..." moves to the bottom of the Source section. Fixes the thin see-through line between the title bar and the window.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Fixes 1.18.4 failing on launch ("ImGui_End: Missing PopStyleVar()"). Layout and styling: "Transfer to Wwise" moves to the bottom left of the window, with its status text beside it. Dropdowns, fields and buttons get slightly rounded corners. Bigger, matching section titles on the left (Source, Wwise destination, Wwise structure). "Settings presets..." moves to the bottom of the Source section. Fixes the thin see-through line between the title bar and the window.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Settings > Configuration: Export / Import configuration saves the complete setup to a file (every tab, all structure and settings presets, the window's look) and loads it back. "Settings presets..." moved from the main window to Settings > Configuration. Section titles a little smaller (still matching).

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: "?" (guide) and Settings buttons moved up next to the close X, same size and style.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Tighter top: the connection status (dot, Wwise project, Wwise version) moves into the title bar next to the ?, Settings and close buttons, in a smaller font. The "Wwise Tool" title moves down into the window in a larger, bold font.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: The big "Wwise Tool" title moves up into the title bar (left side, level with the buttons), removing the empty band at the top of the window.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Window background is now grey (#191919) instead of black, title bar included. Fixes the see-through line around the window's edge: the border is now solid. Title nudged a little further right.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Fixes the see-through line between the title bar and the window for good: the whole window background is now drawn as one shape, so there's no seam left to see through.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: "Transfer to Wwise" is as wide as the left panel and sits in the window's bottom-left corner, the same distance from the bottom as from the left, with its rounded corner following the window's (window corners slightly rounder to match).

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Smaller gap between the "Wwise Tool" title and the tabs.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: A little more room above the "Wwise Tool" title. Preview's Originals file column shows the END of the path when it's too narrow (the start is cut off instead); hover it to scroll back and forth through the whole path.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Originals file column now really shows the END of long paths (the start is cut off), and hovering a path scrolls it slowly back and forth. The cell's width is found from where ImGui clips it (ReaImGui reports the full table width inside a cell). The X in the close button is exactly centred, and the ?, Settings and X buttons sit a little further from the right edge so the space there matches the space above them. Wwise structure table has rounded corners and a little padding around its fields, and the + and - buttons sit closer together with bigger symbols. The drag handle is centred in its column. Source column: "Item render" is now "Item" and "Folder render" is now "Folder item".
